web.title: Lola Launches AI-Powered Experiences, Memberships, and New Partners
web.description: Lola Launches AI-Powered Experiences, Memberships, and New Partners ... # Lola Launches AI-Powered Experiences, Memberships, and New Partners ... Backed by Booking Holdings, Lola helps you discover and book hotels, restaurants, events, and activities in one AI-powered conversation. Membership is free, with Plus ($5/month) and VIP ($ 25/month) adding preferred rates, priority dining, travel perks, and personal concierge access. ### Lola, the AI Assistant for Experiences, Debuts With New Membership Plans and Travel and Lifestyle Partners ... **NEW YORK, Sept. 29, 2026 **— Lola, the new AI assistant for experiences backed by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), today debuts with a new membership offering that combines personalized recommendations, live availability and pricing, direct booking, preferred rates, and benefits. Lola brings discovery and booking into a single experience for hotels, restaurants, events, and more, while providing access to rates and benefits traditionally reserved for loyalty programs and premium cardholders. Unlike AI assistants that stop at recommendations, Lola is designed to take people from “What should I do?” to “I’ve booked it.” Members can ask Lola for anything from a hotel or restaurant to an event, activity, or an entire trip. Lola’s launch partners include ResX,** BLADE, Aero, SeatGeek, GetYourGuide, Nuitee, and Ten Group, alongside Booking Holdings brands including Booking.com, OpenTable, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda, and FareHarbor.** Lola searches for real-time availability and pricing so members can compare options and book directly through the same conversation. It understands requests in natural language, carries context through follow-up questions, and learns what matters to each member to make future recommendations more personal. Paid plans provide preferred hotel rates, priority dining, airport services, premium transportation, and live concierge access. Search results and recommendations are objective and unbiased, never influenced by vendor payments, featured placements, advertising, or sponsorship. “We built Lola to give everyone the advantage of being well connected. The next generation of AI assistants should do more than answer questions. They should understand what you’re looking for, help you decide, and make it happen,” said **Steve Hafner, co-founder of Lola. “**Paid membership plans enhance access through preferred rates, sought-after reservations, and human help without requiring a particular credit card.” ## Personalized Discovery Meets Member Access Anyone can become a Lola member for free, with access to conversational discovery, personalized recommendations across multiple categories, current availability and pricing, and direct booking on Lola. Members who want more benefits can upgrade to Plus for $5 per month or VIP for $25 per month, each with a 12-month commitment. Both plans** **add preferred pricing and benefits through Lola’s partner network, including hotel savings, priority dining, airport services, and concierge support. VIP unlocks Lola’s highest level of benefits and access. ... ## Benefits and Perks Lola’s membership benefits are designed to support the different ways members use Lola, from choosing where to stay to deciding what to do and how to get there. - **Hotels: **All three membership plans include KAYAK’s comprehensive results from hundreds of travel sites. Through Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, and Nuitee, Lola Plus members receive preferred hotel rates, typically saving 10% on qualifying hotels. VIPs receive Lola's best hotel rates, with savings of up to 15% at four- and five-star hotels worldwide. - **Dining: **OpenTable provides VIPs with complimentary Gold status and priority dining benefits. ResX gives Plus members two days of advance access to sought-after reservations, while VIP members receive Premium status with five-day advance availability. - **Live events and activities: **SeatGeek, GetYourGuide, and FareHarbor give Lola members access and preferred pricing on more than 200,000 experiences worldwide, including sporting events, concerts, museums, and attractions. - **Premium airport services: **VIPs receive access to $150 BLADE airport helicopter transfers to and from New York City. Aero provides savings on first flights, with Plus members receiving $300 off and VIPs $400 off. - **Personal concierge: **Ten Group, the global concierge and lifestyle management company, gives Plus members quarterly access to a personal concierge and exclusive amenities. VIP members receive more extensive access to personal concierge and amenities each quarter. "Every partner we add gives members more to choose from and more reasons to be a member," said Paul English, co-founder of Lola. “Lola learns what each member likes and searches across hotels, restaurants, events, and experiences to find the options worth their time, with member rates and perks attached. We’re building Lola to be comprehensive, and there are many more partners to come.” ... Lola is led by Steve Hafner and Paul English, serial entrepreneurs whose experience includes Orbitz, KAYAK, OpenTable, Trulia, SeatGeek, Boston Light, Boston Venture Studio, and the Institute for Applied AI. Together, they have a history of building successful businesses that make it easier for consumers to navigate complex choices. Lola is headquartered in New York City. Lola is an AI assistant for experiences that helps people discover and book hotels, restaurants, events, and more. By combining personalized AI with exclusive member pricing, premium benefits, and leading travel and lifestyle partners, Lola gives members the advantages of being well connected. Recommendations are based on what's right for each member, not paid placements or sponsorship. Backed by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), Lola is open to everyone with free and paid memberships. Learn more at Lola.com. Follow @lolainsiders on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

web.description: KAYAK Co-Founders Launch Lola With Free AI Travel and Paid Memberships # KAYAK Co-Founders Launch Lola With Free AI Travel and Paid Memberships ... ### The new service keeps its core AI travel experience free while paid plans at $5 and $25 a month offer better rates, reservation access and concierge help with a 12-month commitment. Lola, the new AI travel and experiences service from KAYAK co-founders Steve Hafner and Paul English, debuted September 29 with a free membership and two paid plans scheduled to follow this fall. ... ## The Core Experience Is Free Free members can use Lola to search for hotels, restaurants and experiences, get personalized recommendations, see current pricing and availability, make bookings and save their preferences. Plus is currently advertised at $5 a month with a 12-month commitment. Benefits include hotel savings of up to 10%, earlier access to some restaurant reservations, GetYourGuide discounts, an Aero credit and quarterly concierge help. VIP is currently advertised at $25 a month, also with a 12-month commitment. It includes hotel savings of up to 15%, OpenTable Gold, expanded restaurant access, transportation perks and more frequent concierge help. ... Lola is not charging members to use the core AI experience. Paid members are being asked to pay for better prices, greater access and concierge help around the travel and experiences they book. Free members can still use Lola and complete bookings. Lola is betting that the added savings, access and service will give some customers a reason to upgrade. ## $5 a Month Comes With a 12-Month Commitment Lola’s pricing page shows Plus at $5 per month and VIP at $25 per month, with “12 month commitment” directly beneath each price. At the prices Lola currently advertises, Plus represents a $60 first-year commitment and VIP a $300 first-year commitment. ... ## Lola Can Make Money From Memberships and Bookings ... to make money ... A free member can still book through Lola, giving the company an opportunity to earn revenue from the transaction. Plus and VIP add recurring membership revenue from customers who want the extra savings and access. ... Lola is giving subscription operators a useful example of how AI can fit into a membership model without becoming the paid product itself. Free members can search, plan and book. Paid members get better rates, greater access and concierge help. Lola can also earn money from bookings made through the service. That means free members can still generate revenue, while Plus and VIP create recurring revenue from customers who want more. The strategy is straightforward: use AI to make the service useful to a broad audience, then charge for added value around the transactions customers are already making. Lola is betting that better rates, access and concierge help will give some customers a reason to pay even though the core AI experience is free. ... - Lola, “Lola Launches AI ... , Memberships ... and New Partners,” ... 026. ...
